caption: 2am and she just ate Taco Bell:
title: 2am and she just ate Taco Bell 😐

through_line.name: the paper drive-thru bag
through_line.prop_prompt: a crumpled brown paper takeout bag with the top rolled over twice, grease darkening one corner, a small square sauce packet tucked into the fold
progression: a paper bag silhouette descending in the dark
the bag scraping down, heavier than it looks
the bag splits open and three tacos spill out with faces
the tacos have settled into a small huddle
a sauce packet floats free and drifts past
the bag lies flat and empty on the cavity floor

blocks.through_line_state: a paper bag silhouette descending in the dark
blocks.sfx: a paper crinkle, one distant car engine, a slow gulp
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes alone in the dark tube, whispering downward
CLOSE, low angle: Gut's eyes snapping open in the gloom
MEDIUM, high angle: a paper bag shape descending slowly above Pipes
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut staring straight up, unblinking

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Hey. You awake down there?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's two in the morning.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: I know. She just ordered tacos.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Tacos. At two in the morning.

blocks.through_line_state: the bag scraping down, heavier than it looks
blocks.sfx: a dragging scrape, a paper tear, a strained creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut yelling up the tube, brows down hard
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes flattened sideways as the bag drags past
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes counting something going by
MEDIUM, high angle: the bag catching, tearing, sliding on

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Nope. We closed at eleven.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Tell her that. She's in a drive-thru.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There are four items in that bag.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Five. She added a cinnamon thing.

blocks.through_line_state: the bag splits open and three tacos spill out with faces
blocks.sfx: a soft splat, a paper rustle, three cheerful pops
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the bag lands and splits, contents spilling out
CLOSE, low angle: one taco opens two friendly eyes and smiles up
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut leaning back, entirely still
CLOSE on the eyes: two more tacos pop into frame beside the first

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Oh, come on.

turns.speaker: taco
turns.line: Evening! Hope we're not interrupting.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You're a taco. It's two AM.

turns.speaker: taco
turns.line: Three of us, technically. And a sauce packet.

blocks.through_line_state: the tacos have settled into a small huddle
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a dull thud, a tired exhale
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ slumped against the veined wall, half asleep on its feet
CLOSE, low angle: the phone slipping in HQ's grip, screen glowing
MEDIUM, high angle: veins shivering as Gut's voice comes up through the floor
CLOSE on HQ's eyes, refusing to open all the way

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, why are we awake right now?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: That's above my pay grade.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You approved this. You pressed the order button.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: I was asleep. Probably.

blocks.through_line_state: a sauce packet floats free and drifts past
blocks.sfx: a heavy shuffle, a long sigh, a wet plop
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Liv hauling into frame, one brow already raised
MEDIUM, eye level: Liv turning away mid-sentence
MEDIUM, high angle: a small sauce packet drifting past between them
CLOSE on the eyes: Liv's lids dropping shut

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Liv! I need you down here.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: Oh, so now y'all remember me.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There's a sauce packet situation.

turns.speaker: liv
turns.line: I handle drinks. That's grease. Good luck.

blocks.through_line_state: the bag lies flat and empty on the cavity floor
blocks.sfx: one low rumble, a long silence, a single drip
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the dark tunnel, completely still
CLOSE, low angle: Gut peering down into it, hopeful
MEDIUM, high angle: two calm eyes opening far back in the amber dark
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty blinks once, slowly

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It got quiet. Maybe we're fine down here.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: You are not fine.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Rusty, please. Not tonight, man.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Set an alarm for four.
